author: HoneyDataV2
description:
Honey-Data-V2
	

A multimodal supervised fine-tuning corpus of 19,707,852 image groups carrying 44,295,078 conversations, spread over 8 task categories and 420 subsets (5.81 TB).
Honey-Data-V2 extends Honey-Data-15M,
the corpus behind Bee-8B. The original pool was re-curated under
stricter structural rules, re-annotated by an upgraded stack of frontier models that contributes up
to three independent answers per instruction, and extended with newly released community corpora.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/HoneyDataV2/Honey-Data-V2.
